name: MMHal-Bench
description: MMHal-Bench is a multimodal benchmark that evaluates hallucination and grounding failures in vision–language models. It contains examples designed to provoke ungrounded assertions and tests a model's factual consistency and grounding across image+text inputs. The benchmark supports automated and human-evaluation protocols to measure hallucination rates and correction capability.
evaluation_method: accuracy, F1, and human_eval (for nuanced hallucination judgments)
reputation: A niche, recently published benchmark with limited but growing use for evaluating multimodal hallucination in research and on Hugging Face.
